segments.name: Google Services
segments.note: Search, YouTube ads, Google Network and subscriptions/platforms/devices — up 11% YoY. Search & other was $63,350M, YouTube ads $11,207M, Google advertising $82,012M in total.

segments.name: Google Cloud
segments.note: Cloud infrastructure and AI services — more than doubled, up 103% YoY, powered by demand for AI infrastructure and TPUs. The quarter's standout.

segments.name: Other Bets
segments.note: Moonshot bets such as Waymo — up 8% YoY, still small and loss-making (operating loss of $2,047M).

segments.name: Hedging gains
segments.note: Currency-hedging gains added to revenue this quarter, vs a $207M hedging loss a year ago.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building AI models, TPUs and products — up 36% YoY, the fastest-growing cost line as AI investment accelerates.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling Google products and cloud — up 22% YoY.

oneTimers: Other income swung to a net expense of $8,221M from $12,759M of income a year ago, driven by an $8,664M loss on equity securities (vs a $10,734M gain a year ago) — this $19.4B swing is why net income fell 24% despite operating income rising 30%. Note: the income statement's net income of $26,468M is before $298M of preferred stock dividends; net income available to common stockholders was $26,170M, on which the $2.12 EPS is based.
verdict: Google's operating profit rose 30% and Cloud more than doubled — but an $8.7B paper loss on its stock holdings turned the bottom line down 24%.
otherDetail: Other expense of $8,221M, driven by an $8,664M loss on equity securities.
footerNote: Net income of $26,468M is before $298M of preferred stock dividends; EPS is based on $26,170M to common stockholders.
follow100Note: The rows add to $99.99 due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Cloud more than doubled
takeaways.text: Google Cloud grew 103% to $30.7B, and its operating income tripled to $11.1B — a 36% margin. Cloud is now a quarter of Alphabet's revenue.

takeaways.title: The paper loss that sank the bottom line
takeaways.text: An $8.7B mark-to-market loss on equity securities swung other income from +$12.8B to -$8.2B. Operating profit rose 30%, but net income fell 24%.

takeaways.title: Gemini hit a billion users
takeaways.text: The Gemini app reached one billion users — called the fastest-growing product in Google's history — and YouTube Music and Premium passed 150 million subscribers.
